responsibility: Implements the RTL hard-register renaming pass that postprocesses allocator results to improve register-file use and reduce conflicts. It builds local def-use chains within and across basic blocks, tracks chain conflicts and call clobbers, computes feasible and preferred replacement hard registers, and rewrites chains to alternative hard regs using a round-robin selection strategy while honoring operand classes and debug-insn constraints. This pass is distinct from allocation: it opportunistically renames already-allocated hard-register uses.
same_name_distinction: This same-stem source file is the implementation of the RTL hard-register renaming pass itself: it builds and analyzes chains, computes conflicts and replacement choices, and performs the rewrites. The companion header gcc/regrename.h defines the shared chain/operand data structures and declares the renamer APIs used by other code.
